blurb: Fainting Goat Vineyards is a boutique, family-owned winery near Ellijay, Georgia, nestled in the Blue Ridge Mountains. Guests can enjoy handcrafted wines, scenic mountain views, and live music every weekend. The winery offers wine tastings served as portable flights, seasonal events, and unique vineyard experiences.
